{{Quote|Master Katarn has informed me that he is continuing his investigation of Rosh Penin's disappearance near Nar Kreeta and can assist you on this mission.|[[Jedi Praxeum protocol droid]]|audio=NarKreeta-RescueMission.flac|<ref name="JKJA" />}}
The '''Nar Kreeta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Kreeta]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] colony and major [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world, and was intersected by the ''[[Pabol Kreeta/Legends|Pabol Kreeta]]'' and [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. During the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]], the [[Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Nar Kreeta)|local Hutt crime lord]] based on Nar Kreeta kidnapped [[Mining Guild elders|members]] of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] sent to negotiate a treaty with him, prompting a [[New Jedi Order]] [[Mission to Nar Kreeta|rescue mission]] successfully undertaken by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]]. The system was one of many that fell to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], with the main planet of Nar Kreeta being [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] invaders, until its reconstruction by the Hutts after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong campaign]].

==Description==
[[File:JKAlevelshot_t2_rancor.png|thumb|left|180px|General location of Nar Kreeta on a galactic map, with its main planet of Nar Kreeta pictured]]
The Nar Kreeta system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the edge of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] region between the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] historically dominated by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The system was notable for its main [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Nar Kreeta]], which was a Hutt colony and a major [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world. It was also crossed by at least two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]: the ''[[Pabol Kreeta/Legends|Pabol Kreeta]]'', which linked Nar Kreeta to [[Nar Bo Sholla]] within the [[Nar Bo Sholla system/Legends|eponymous system]], and the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']], whose endpoints were the worlds [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] and [[Randon/Legends|Randon]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|We have received word from a mining guild on Nar Kreeta that a number of elders are held captive by the local Hutt crimelord. These elders went to negotiate a treaty with the Hutt, but never returned. The crimelord claims no one ever came to see him.|[[Jedi Praxeum]] records|<ref name="JKJA" />}}
The territory surrounding the Nar Kreeta system came under the control of the [[Hutt Empire]] as early as the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]] and was considered well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] had control of the planet Nar Kreeta, although Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] dominated the underworld.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|361|Nar Kreeta}}</ref> The Mining Guild's relations with the Hutts were poor. Upon trying to negotiate a treaty with a [[Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Nar Kreeta)|local Hutt crime lord]], sixteen [[Mining Guild elders|Guild elder delegates]] went missing. The Guild suspected a Hutt connection, but the suspect denied that anyone had come to see him.<ref name="JKJA" />

The [[New Jedi Order]]&mdash;which, at the [[Time/Legends|time]], had [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] already in the system's area investigating the disappearance of his pupil, [[Rosh Penin]], amidst the short-lived [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis|conflict]] with the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]]&mdash;picked up the [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from the Guild and [[Mission to Nar Kreeta|dispatched]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]] to learn the truth.<ref name="JKJA" /> At the time, the Hutts maintained a wary coexistence with the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Nar_Kreeta_Vongd.png|thumb|right|180px|During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Nar Kreeta system was one of many that fell to the invaders.]]
Korr covertly entered the [[Rancor betting parlor|Hutt's stronghold]] and soon rescued all sixteen of the [[Prisoner/Legends|captives]], escaping the complex with the elders in Katarn's [[Courier/Legends|light courier]], the ''[[Raven's Claw]]''. Over the course of his investigation in the Nar Kreeta system, Katarn eventually found that Penin had been captured by the Disciples of Ragnos and that they had been in the region, although he could not know for certain where exactly they had taken Penin next.<ref name="JKJA" />

Sometime around [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Nar Kreeta system, like great portions of Hutt [[Realspace/Legends|Space]], fell to the [[Yuuzhan Vong|extra-galactic invaders]]' [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|empire]], which heavily [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] Nar Kreeta. The [[Battle of the Nar Kreeta system|attack on the system]] was a part of the Vong incursion in Hutt territories, and was preceded by an [[Battle of the Nimban system|assault]] on the [[Nimban system/Legends|Nimban system]] and followed by an [[Battle of the Nar Bo Sholla system|battle on the Nar Bo Sholla system]]. After the invasion, which did not last more than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] for some territories, the Hutts focused on reconstructing the planets affected by the Yuuzhan Vong campaign.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Although Hutts were the original settlers of Nar Kreeta and Hutt Space as a whole,<ref name="TEA" /> other species could also occasionally be found in the system, like [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]],<ref name="JKJA" /> and Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="TEA" /> Consequently, [[Language/Legends|languages]] as varied as [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], [[Gran (language)/Legends|Gran]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]], [[Sriluurian]],<ref name="JKJA" /> and [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="LECG" /> were spoken in the system at various times. On Nar Kreeta, [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and a [[Huttese (standard writing system)/Legends|Huttese script]] could be seen in certain locations, in the form of signs and posters.<ref name="JKJA" /> By 25 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the system boasted a population of anything from one to ten billion individuals.<ref name="TEA" />

==Orbital bodies==
===Nar Kreeta===
[[File:Nar_Kreeta_JA.png|thumb|left|100px|Nar Kreeta]]
{{Main|Nar Kreeta}}
Nar Kreeta was a Hutt colony and major trade world at the nexus of the ''Pabol Kreeta'' and in the ''Pabol Sleheyron''.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet possessed a rocky and [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] landscape<ref name="JKJA" /> prior to its Vongforming,<ref name="TEA" /> where some inhabited settlements were built underground.<ref name="JKJA" /> During the early years of the New Republic, the Mining Guild controlled the planet, although Hutt crime lords dominated the underworld.<ref name="CSWE" /> It was terraformed by the Yuuzhan Vong upon their invasion in Hutt Space, though, after they were defeated, the Hutts concentrated efforts on reconstructing the worlds devastated by the invaders.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nar Kreeta system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a third-generation [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|''Essential Guide'']] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published in [[August]] [[2009]]. The book placed the system in Hutt Space, at coordinates S-10.<ref name="TEA" />

Fry has stated that "planets not assigned a system in [a] published source can be assumed to reside in [the] system of [the] same name."<ref name="JFnote" /> This article assumes the same applies for Nar Kreeta, a planet first introduced in the [[2003]] [[Raven Software]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', the last installment of the [[Dark Forces/Jedi Knight|''Dark Forces'' saga]].<ref name="JKJA" />
